schema:name: Finished Green-coffee Handling, Sidamo Province, Ethiopia
schema:description: This image depicts skilled laborers handling bags of packaged green coffee beans. Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations.
